raw_text: This stealth drone image from Ladakh is making rounds. The design looks incredible but something about the lighting and textures seems off. Has anyone checked if this might be a render or AI-generated? The mountain shadows don't look quite right and the drone surface has that typical Midjourney smoothness. Would love to see EXIF data.
clean_text: Reddit user questions stealth drone image. Notes suspicious lighting, textures, and Midjourney-like smoothness. Requests EXIF data verification. Suspects AI generation.
